mapper.select: SELECT /* getCurrentUserMenu */ MENUMATCH.MENU_NUMB , MENUMATCH.PARN_NUMB , MENUMATCH.MENU_LEVL , MENUMATCH.MENU_NAME , MENUMATCH.MENU_URLX , MENUMATCH.SORT_ORDR FROM ( SELECT MENU.MENU_NUMB , MENU.PARN_NUMB , MENU.MENU_LEVL , MENU.MENU_NAME , MENU.MENU_URLX , MENU.SORT_ORDR FROM TM_URMENU MENU WHERE MENU.MENU_URLX IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(MENU.MENU_URLX) != 0 AND MENU.USEE_YSNO = #{commYes} AND ( TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM MENU.MENU_URLX) = TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM #{menuUrlx}) OR TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM #{menuUrlx}) LIKE CONCAT(TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM MENU.MENU_URLX), '/%') ) ORDER BY LENGTH(MENU.MENU_URLX) DESC ) MENUMATCH LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE VISIBLE_MENU AS ( SELECT MENU_NUMB , PARN_NUMB , MENU_LEVL , MENU_NAME , MENU_URLX , SORT_ORDR FROM TM_URMENU WHERE PARN_NUMB IS NULL AND SHOW_YSNO = #{commYes} AND USEE_YSNO = #{commYes} UNION ALL SELECT CHILD.MENU_NUMB , CHILD.PARN_NUMB , CHILD.MENU_LEVL , CHILD.MENU_NAME , CHILD.MENU_URLX , CHILD.SORT_ORDR FROM TM_URMENU CHILD JOIN VISIBLE_MENU PARENT ON PARENT.MENU_NUMB = CHILD.PARN_NUMB WHERE CHILD.SHOW_YSNO = #{commYes} AND CHILD.USEE_YSNO = #{commYes} AND CHILD.MENU_LEVL <= 3 ) SELECT /* getVisibleUserMenuList */ MENU_NUMB , PARN_NUMB , MENU_LEVL , MENU_NAME , MENU_URLX , SORT_ORDR FROM VISIBLE_MENU ORDER BY MENU_LEVL , COALESCE(PARN_NUMB, 0) , COALESCE(SORT_ORDR, 9999) , MENU_NUMB
